objectives: 讓學生了解強震地動之觀測、分析及其影響因子。
content: 本課程探討強震地動現象之原因、觀測及分析。內容包括:1.強震地動學簡介2.彈性力學基本原理3.震源對地震動的影響4.震波路徑對地震動的影響5.區域場址對地震動的影響6.強地動模擬
books:
1. Aki, K. and P. G. Richards (1980). Quantitative seismology: theory and methods, W.H. Freeman and Co., New York.
2. Achenbach, J. D. (1975). Wave propagation in elastic solids, North-Holland Publishing Company, New York.
3. Bolt, B. A. (1987). Seismic strong motion synthetics, Academic Press, Inc., New York.
4. Erdik, M.O. and M. N. Toksoz (1987). Strong ground motion seismology, D. Reidel Publishing Company.
5. Anderson, J.G. (2015). 4.20 - Physical Processes That Control Strong Ground Motion, Treatise on Geophysics, ScienceDirect.
grading_policy: 平時成績(30％)、期中考/報告(35％)、期末考/報告(35％)
